Classic action-figure proportions — broad shoulders, defined chest, tapered waist, and limbs that suggest both strength and agility.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Heroic Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Heroic frame — idealized athletic proportions, broad shoulders tapering to narrow waist, defined muscle without excess bulk. Classical superhero silhouette. Female: shoulders defined tapering to a waist drawn near the hip line, slim neck, soft jaw, the chest line above a sharply drawn waist. Male: shoulders broad over narrow hips, strong neck, square jaw, a broad flat chest tapering to the waist. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure idealized.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
